ETS2550C.title: SCADA Systems
ETS2550C.prerequisites: Statewide record: ETS 2544 (PLCs II). Indian River (ETS 2550): ETS 2676 Introduction to Robotics, which follows ETS 2542 PLCs I. Lake-Sumter (ETS 2550C): not confirmed. Either way, arrive able to program a PLC. ETS 2550 and ETS 2550C are the same statewide course filed two ways and transfer as one. Do not confuse with ETS 2556 Introduction to SCADA Cybersecurity (Northwest Florida State), a different, security-focused course. Only two Florida public colleges offer ETS x550, so a receiving school may have no match; ask whether it counts as a technical elective.

offering_notes.summary: Two public carriers, both at 3 credits: Lake-Sumter State College (ETS 2550C) and Indian River State College (ETS 2550, unsuffixed). Neither publishes contact hours.
offering_notes.derivation: Florida convention for a 3-credit integrated C course, the requested identifier. Indian River's unsuffixed version carries a $20 lab fee.
